review.summary: All required Regession module elements are present and structurally correct. The overview uses the mandated language, covers all four analytical areas (estimates, predictor effects, scenario, and diagnostics/influence), and is visually mapped. Three distinct demonstrations are performed, each pairing a control/action with a clear, visible response and narration that explains intent and result. The scenario demonstration has been reframed so the slider, prediction, and affected chart are readable together through the entire action, with needed context, addressing the previous required issue. The feature catalogue is shown in two pages: verified features and 'not in this build,' introduced with the required narration and held for reading. Visual attention (highlight) adheres to the updated specification (#D9B878, 1.5px, 4px radius, no glow/shadow/brackets) and is tracked via the highlight log and overlay constants, as direct 200ms fade proof is not provided by sampled frames alone. No missing required or advisory items are found; all narration, controls, catalogue, and reading holds meet production and script standards.
